purpose: Teach: 東日本/東亜/堺/生き残り/脳裏/紡/転生/テクスト

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、東日本地域への支援事業を継続しろ
lines.en: I want this company to keep supporting the Kanto region.
lines.style: Measured opening. Authority without harshness. Each clause lands with weight. Pause at the period — expectation of compliance is implicit.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。東亜地域への市場展開を進めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll accelerate our market entry into East Asia.
lines.style: Steady, professional acknowledgement. Slightly forward-leaning. Confidence in the plan beneath the formality. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、堺の工場の生産能力を上げろ
lines.en: I need this company to increase production capacity at the Sakai plant.
lines.style: Direct instruction. Slight emphasis on 'increase'—this matters. Clear but not cold. The tone of someone who has thought this through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倒産危機からの生き残り戦略を共有します
lines.en: Yes. We'll share the survival strategy we've developed from the bankruptcy crisis.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Takes the weight of the previous instruction seriously. Speaking from preparation, not improvisation. Grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の脳裏に残るブランドイメージを大事にしろ
lines.en: This company must protect the brand image that stays in our employees' minds.
lines.style: Shift to something deeper—less tactical. Slower pace. The word 'protect' carries conviction. Almost philosophical in its weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業の理念を絶やさず紡いで行きます
lines.en: Understood. We'll preserve the founding vision and pass it forward without letting it fade.
lines.style: Softer than before—reverence underneath the professionalism. A promise, not just a response. Slight pause before 'pass it forward.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業者の精神を後世に転生、つまり継承させろ
lines.en: The founder's spirit must be inherited by the next generation—not lost.
lines.style: Quieter now. More weight per word. This is the deepest principle being stated. Measured breathing. The finality of 'not lost' carries consequence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内文書のテクスト、つまり原文の管理を徹底します
lines.en: Yes. We'll enforce rigorous management of all internal documents and records.
lines.style: Close with precision. Even and steady. The thoroughness is absolute. This is how legacy is protected—through discipline and care.
